scope: One disposable PostgreSQL database, same data within before/after pair; 3 warmup + 7 EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS; SQL execution only

inventoryListBefore.sql: SELECT i.*,w.name warehouse_name,p.sku,p.name,p.safety_stock FROM coreerp.inventory i JOIN coreerp.products p ON p.id=i.product_id JOIN coreerp.warehouses w ON w.id=i.warehouse_id WHERE ($1::bigint IS NULL OR i.warehouse_id=$1) AND (p.sku ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '!' OR p.name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY i.warehouse_id,i.product_id LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

inventoryCountBefore.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM coreerp.inventory i JOIN coreerp.products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE ($1::bigint IS NULL OR i.warehouse_id=$1) AND (p.sku ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '!' OR p.name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '!')

inventoryListAfter.sql: SELECT i.*,w.name warehouse_name,p.sku,p.name,p.safety_stock FROM coreerp.inventory i JOIN coreerp.products p ON p.id=i.product_id JOIN coreerp.warehouses w ON w.id=i.warehouse_id ORDER BY i.warehouse_id,i.product_id LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

salesByPeriod.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'),'YYYY-MM-DD') period,sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity)::text amount,count(DISTINCT s.id) shipments FROM coreerp.shipments s JOIN coreerp.sales_orders o ON o.id=s.sales_order_id JOIN coreerp.shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id=s.id JOIN coreerp.sales_order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id AND oi.product_id=si.product_id WHERE s.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at >= $1 AND s.created_at < $2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
